# onenote-mcp

FastMCP 3.4 server for Microsoft OneNote via the Graph API: notebook/section/page browsing,
page creation, full-text search, and TOC generation. HTTP (Streamable) + stdio dual transport,
Tauri/NSIS desktop wrapper, and a Vite React webapp (dashboard, notebooks browser, chat, logging).

- Full reference: [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt)
- Ports: backend 10907 (`/mcp`, `/api/*`), webapp 10906 (Vite dev)
- Auth: Microsoft device-code flow (`authenticate` tool or Settings page)
